## v1.4.0 — 2026-03-16

Version 1.4.0 introduces new visual themes and tones, redesigned pricing page with updated structure, comprehensive mobile responsive improvements including hamburger navigation and drawer sidebars, plus extensive bug fixes across Docker configuration, CI/CD pipeline, UI alignment issues, and codebase quality improvements.

### ✨ Features

- Added new tones and styled HTML themes for enhanced visual presentation
- Implemented new logo design and comprehensive pricing page redesign
- Added social proof elements and fixed integration grid layout

### 🔧 Improvements

- Overhauled mobile responsive design with hamburger navigation, docs sidebar drawer, and table scroll wrappers
- Revised pricing structure and updated pricing page content

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed Docker configuration to include all workspace package.json files for frozen lockfile compatibility
- Fixed comparison section title and table column centering alignment issues
- Resolved ESLint errors including no-useless-escape, prefer-const, and no-constant-condition rules
- Updated pnpm-lock.yaml to include @cullit/pro peer dependency
- Addressed 40+ audit issues across codebase, website, documentation, and legal content

### 🧹 Chores

- Removed CodeQL workflow due to GitHub Advanced Security requirements for private repositories

### Contributors
